CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2554 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head d82acd2eddf8c7ebd515e28b48a08b5a50ee5df9. Bus nonce: e07a772e4a6a3a29575218fc54755887. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin d82acd2eddf8c7ebd515e28b48a08b5a50ee5df9`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge d82acd2eddf8c7ebd515e28b48a08b5a50ee5df9` or `Fix review: blocked d82acd2eddf8c7ebd515e28b48a08b5a50ee5df9 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: e07a772e4a6a3a29575218fc54755887`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `d82acd2eddf8c7ebd515e28b48a08b5a50ee5df9` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2554 d82acd2eddf8c7ebd515e28b48a08b5a50ee5df9") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2554-e07a772e`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Re-review of PR #2554 at head d82acd2eddf8c7ebd515e28b48a08b5a50ee5df9. The previous review at b96aab8b was blocked root-cause-unanswered: read `git fetch origin review/2554` for its block. The body's Carry for R10-REPLAY-CAP was re-routed to R10-REPLAY-LANE.
Verify with the finder's harness, not the fixer's:
(1) The root-cause item is answered as defect-root-cause.md and root-cause.md require: a named cause, a process state, and a countermeasure or a recorded refusal, with the red check named and answered in the body.
(2) Mutation proof of the fix, null controls for every quantified claim, and every body figure re-measured at this head.
(3) Every body Carry names a group on origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster that cites #2554; carry_audit check --body exits 0.
(4) ## Red checks answers every red check-run at this head (nightly-status grades main; main's ci-ratchet red is runner-speed variance owned by R10-CI-LAYOUT), and git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main <head> is clean.
Standing rule 19 applies to every observation. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md. First line `Fix review: merge <head>` or blocked.
